attributes.board_name: Illinois Department of Financial and Professional Regulation (IDFPR)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Programs by approved CE sponsors (in person or remote, live or pre-recorded); graduate MFT courses (1 semester hr = 15 CE hrs); teaching; publications/presentations to LMFT audiences
rules.new_licensee_rule: CE not required for the first renewal of a license. Associate LMFT licenses cannot be renewed and need no CE.
rules.audit_note: Licensee answers a YES/NO CE question at renewal; proof only on random audit, restoration or discipline. Keep proof of CE.
rules.alternatives: One-time CE waiver may be requested with the renewal (before expiry) for full-time military service, incapacitating illness or similar extenuating circumstances.

topics.who: Alzheimer's disease and other dementias; once every 3 renewal periods

rules.notes: CE must be completed in the 24 months before the expiration date printed on the license. Statutory expiry date not confirmed (ilga.gov admin code unreachable).
rules.legal_basis: 68 Ill. Adm. Code 1283.110 and 68 Ill. Adm. Code 1130 Subpart E
